---
title: "Explore the bikes"
description: "Stack and reach for every size of 24 current gravel bikes, with filters and the key handling numbers."
---

Every dot is one frame size. Lines join the sizes of the same bike, smallest to largest. Up means a taller front end. Right means a longer one.

- **Stack** is how high the top of the head tube sits above the pedals' axle (the bottom bracket).
- **Reach** is how far forward it sits.
- **Stack-to-reach ratio** sums up the posture. Race bikes sit lower and longer (around 1.40), adventure bikes taller and shorter (1.50 and up). The faint diagonal lines mark ratios so you can see the clusters.

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Shared chart settings from the brand kit (Space Mono axes and defaults)
import {ebPlot} from "./js/eb_charts.js"
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
raw = FileAttachment("data/gravel_geometry_derived.csv").csv({typed: true})
import {cockpit, partsFor, DEFAULTS} from "./js/rider.js"

// R writes TRUE/FALSE; make them true booleans
bikes = raw.map(d => ({
  ...d,
  is_default_config: d.is_default_config === true || d.is_default_config === "TRUE",
  offset_estimated: d.offset_estimated === true || d.offset_estimated === "TRUE",
  size_label: String(d.size_label),
  label: `${d.brand} ${d.model}`
})).map(d => {
  // Handlebar position as sold: stock stem (or the standard one for a 176 cm
  // rider where the brand doesn't say) on 20 mm of spacers
  const parts = partsFor(d, 1760);
  const bar = cockpit(d, {...DEFAULTS, ...parts.settings}).bar;
  const stemKnown = !parts.assumed.includes("stem length");
  return {...d, bar_reach: bar.x, bar_stack: bar.y, stem_known: stemKnown,
    stem_desc: `${parts.settings.stemLength} mm at ${parts.settings.stemAngle}°${stemKnown ? (parts.assumed.includes("stem angle") ? ", angle not stated" : "") : ", not stated"}`};
})

categories = ["race", "all-round", "adventure"]
categoryNames = ({"race": "Race", "all-round": "All-round", "adventure": "Adventure"})
categoryColours = ["#2340FF", "#E0431B", "#00664B"]
categoryShapes = ["circle", "square", "triangle"]

brandList = Array.from(new Set(bikes.map(d => d.brand))).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
bikeList = Array.from(new Set(bikes.map(d => d.label))).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
```

::: {.explore-grid .column-page}

::: {.filter-panel}
[Filters]{.sidebar-heading}

```{ojs}
viewof cats = Inputs.checkbox(categories, {
  label: "Category",
  value: categories,
  format: c => categoryNames[c]
})
```

::: {.brand-list}
```{ojs}
viewof brands = {
  const list = Inputs.checkbox(brandList, {label: "Brand", value: brandList});
  // Set the list's value and tell Observable it changed
  const setTo = v => {
    list.value = v;
    list.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
  };
  const all = html`<button type="button">Select all</button>`;
  const none = html`<button type="button">Deselect all</button>`;
  all.onclick = () => setTo(brandList);
  none.onclick = () => setTo([]);
  const wrapper = html`<div>${list}<div class="filter-buttons">${all}${none}</div></div>`;
  Object.defineProperty(wrapper, "value", {get: () => list.value, set: v => { list.value = v; }});
  return wrapper;
}
```
:::

```{ojs}
viewof minClearance = Inputs.range([45, 61], {
  label: "Fits tyres at least this wide (mm)",
  value: 45, step: 1
})
```

```{ojs}
viewof reachRange = Inputs.form([
  Inputs.range([340, 460], {label: "Reach from (mm)", value: 340, step: 5}),
  Inputs.range([340, 460], {label: "Reach to (mm)", value: 460, step: 5})
])
```

```{ojs}
viewof stackRange = Inputs.form([
  Inputs.range([500, 670], {label: "Stack from (mm)", value: 500, step: 5}),
  Inputs.range([500, 670], {label: "Stack to (mm)", value: 670, step: 5})
])
```

```{ojs}
viewof showAlternatives = Inputs.toggle({
  label: "Include flip chip and fork-insert settings",
  value: false
})
```

```{ojs}
viewof highlight = Inputs.select(["(none)", ...bikeList], {label: "Highlight a bike", value: "(none)"})
```
:::

::: {.chart-panel}
```{ojs}
viewof chartMode = Inputs.radio(new Map([["Frame stack and reach", "frame"], ["Handlebar stack and reach, as sold", "bar"]]), {value: "frame"})
```

```{ojs}
filtered = bikes.filter(d =>
  cats.includes(d.category) &&
  brands.includes(d.brand) &&
  d.tyre_clearance_mm >= minClearance &&
  d.reach >= Math.min(...reachRange) && d.reach <= Math.max(...reachRange) &&
  d.stack >= Math.min(...stackRange) && d.stack <= Math.max(...stackRange) &&
  (showAlternatives || d.is_default_config)
)

nBikes = new Set(filtered.map(d => d.bike_id)).size

html`<div class="chart-title">${chartMode === "bar" ? "Handlebar stack and reach, every size" : "Stack and reach, every size"}</div>
<div class="chart-sub">Showing ${filtered.length} sizes from ${nBikes} ${nBikes === 1 ? "bike" : "bikes"}. ${chartMode === "bar" ? "Measured to the centre of the stem's bar clamp, with each size's stock stem on 20 mm of spacers. Open markers: the brand doesn't say which stem it fits, so a standard one is assumed. " : ""}Hover over a dot for details.</div>`
```

```{ojs}
legend = {
  const shapePath = {
    circle: `<circle cx="7" cy="7" r="5"/>`,
    square: `<rect x="2.5" y="2.5" width="9" height="9"/>`,
    triangle: `<path d="M7 1.5 L12.5 12 L1.5 12 Z"/>`
  };
  const items = categories.map((c, i) => `<span><svg width="14" height="14" aria-hidden="true"><g fill="${categoryColours[i]}" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1">${shapePath[categoryShapes[i]]}</g></svg>${categoryNames[c]}</span>`);
  const div = document.createElement("div");
  div.className = "gg-legend";
  div.innerHTML = items.join("");
  return div;
}
```

```{ojs}
// What's plotted: frame stack and reach, or the handlebar position as sold
xKey = chartMode === "bar" ? "bar_reach" : "reach"
yKey = chartMode === "bar" ? "bar_stack" : "stack"
barExt = ({x: d3.extent(bikes, d => d.bar_reach), y: d3.extent(bikes, d => d.bar_stack)})
xDom = chartMode === "bar" ? [Math.floor((barExt.x[0] - 8) / 10) * 10, Math.ceil((barExt.x[1] + 8) / 10) * 10] : [335, 470]
yDom = chartMode === "bar" ? [Math.floor((barExt.y[0] - 10) / 10) * 10, Math.ceil((barExt.y[1] + 10) / 10) * 10] : [495, 675]
ratioSet = chartMode === "bar" ? [1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.4, 1.5] : [1.35, 1.45, 1.55, 1.65]

ratioLines = ratioSet.flatMap(r => [
  {r, reach: xDom[0], stack: xDom[0] * r},
  {r, reach: xDom[1], stack: xDom[1] * r}
])

ratioLabels = ratioSet.map(r => {
  // place each label where its line leaves the top or right edge of the plot
  const reach = Math.min(xDom[1] - 2, (yDom[1] - 3) / r);
  return {r, reach, stack: reach * r};
}).filter(d => d.stack >= yDom[0])

plotRows = filtered.map(d => ({...d, px: d[xKey], py: d[yKey]}))

highlighted = plotRows.filter(d => d.label === highlight)

// Size the chart to its own panel rather than the page, so text stays readable
chartWidth = Generators.observe(notify => {
  const el = document.querySelector(".chart-panel");
  const measure = () => notify(Math.max(300, Math.floor(el.getBoundingClientRect().width - 34)));
  const ro = new ResizeObserver(measure);
  ro.observe(el);
  measure();
  return () => ro.disconnect();
})

ebPlot(Plot, {
  width: chartWidth,
  height: Math.min(600, Math.max(360, chartWidth * 0.72)),
  marginLeft: 48,
  marginBottom: 42,
  style: {fontFamily: "'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif", fontSize: "12px", color: "#111111"},
  x: {domain: xDom, label: chartMode === "bar" ? "Handlebar reach (mm) →" : "Reach (mm) →", grid: true},
  y: {domain: yDom, label: chartMode === "bar" ? "↑ Handlebar stack (mm)" : "↑ Stack (mm)", grid: true},
  color: {domain: categories, range: categoryColours},
  symbol: {domain: categories, range: categoryShapes},
  marks: [
    // stack-to-reach guide lines
    Plot.line(ratioLines, {x: "reach", y: "stack", z: "r", stroke: "#DCD4C4", strokeDasharray: "3,4", clip: true}),
    Plot.text(ratioLabels, {x: "reach", y: "stack", text: d => d.r.toFixed(2), dx: -4, dy: 8, textAnchor: "end", fill: "#5A544A", fontSize: 11}),
    chartWidth < 520 ? null : Plot.text([{reach: xDom[0] + 10, stack: yDom[1] - 7}], {x: "reach", y: "stack", text: () => "Taller and shorter: more upright", textAnchor: "start", fill: "#5A544A", fontSize: 11}),
    chartWidth < 520 ? null : Plot.text([{reach: xDom[1] - 4, stack: yDom[0] + 7}], {x: "reach", y: "stack", text: () => "Lower and longer: more stretched out", textAnchor: "end", fill: "#5A544A", fontSize: 11}),

    // size runs, one line per bike and setting
    Plot.line(plotRows, {
      x: "px", y: "py", z: d => `${d.bike_id}|${d.config}`,
      sort: "size_order", stroke: "category", strokeWidth: 1.5,
      strokeOpacity: highlight === "(none)" ? 0.45 : 0.15
    }),
    // stems the brand doesn't state are drawn as open markers
    Plot.dot(plotRows.filter(d => chartMode === "bar" && !d.stem_known), {
      x: "px", y: "py", symbol: "category", stroke: "category", fill: "#ffffff",
      r: 4.2, strokeWidth: 1.6, strokeOpacity: highlight === "(none)" ? 0.95 : 0.3
    }),
    Plot.dot(plotRows, {
      x: "px", y: "py", symbol: "category",
      fill: "category", stroke: "#ffffff",
      filter: d => !(chartMode === "bar" && !d.stem_known),
      r: 4.5, strokeWidth: 1.5,
      fillOpacity: highlight === "(none)" ? 0.95 : 0.25,
      channels: chartMode === "bar" ? {
        Bike: "label", Size: "size_label", Setting: "config",
        "Frame stack/reach": d => `${d.stack} / ${d.reach}`, "Stock stem": "stem_desc"
      } : {
        Bike: "label", Size: "size_label", Setting: "config",
        "Stack/reach": "stack_reach_ratio", "Head angle": "head_tube_angle",
        "Trail (mm)": "trail_calc", "Tyre clearance (mm)": "tyre_clearance_mm"
      },
      tip: {lineWidth: 34, format: {x: d => d.toFixed(0), y: d => d.toFixed(0), fill: false, symbol: false}}
    }),
    // tips for the open markers too
    chartMode === "bar" ? Plot.tip(plotRows.filter(d => !d.stem_known), Plot.pointer({x: "px", y: "py", maxRadius: 10, lineWidth: 34,
      title: d => `${d.label}, size ${d.size_label}\nBar reach ${d.px.toFixed(0)}, bar stack ${d.py.toFixed(0)}\nFrame stack/reach ${d.stack} / ${d.reach}\nStem ${d.stem_desc}`})) : null,

    // highlighted bike drawn on top, with size labels
    Plot.line(highlighted, {x: "px", y: "py", z: d => `${d.bike_id}|${d.config}`, sort: "size_order", stroke: "#111111", strokeWidth: 2.5}),
    Plot.dot(highlighted, {x: "px", y: "py", fill: "category", symbol: "category", r: 6.5, stroke: "#111111", strokeWidth: 1.5}),
    Plot.text(highlighted, {x: "px", y: "py", text: "size_label", dx: 10, textAnchor: "start", fill: "#111111", fontWeight: 600, stroke: "#ffffff", strokeWidth: 3, paintOrder: "stroke"})
  ]
})
```

[Figures are as published by each manufacturer and may change. Where a brand publishes more than one setting (flip chips on the Giant and Liv, the Trail Mixer insert on the Cervélo), the default view shows one.]{.data-note}
:::

## In plain words

Pick a bike and a size for a short summary of what its numbers add up to. It starts on whichever bike you've highlighted above.

```{ojs}
//| output: false
import {explainCard} from "./js/explain.js"
explainPopulation = bikes.filter(d => d.is_default_config)
```

::: {.explain-controls}
```{ojs}
viewof explainBikeName = Inputs.select(bikeList, {label: "Bike", value: highlight !== "(none)" ? highlight : "Norco Search C Gen 3"})
```

```{ojs}
viewof explainSize = {
  const sizes = explainPopulation.filter(d => d.label === explainBikeName).sort((a, b) => a.size_order - b.size_order).map(d => d.size_label);
  return Inputs.select(sizes, {label: "Size", value: sizes[Math.floor(sizes.length / 2)]});
}
```
:::

```{ojs}
explainCard(explainPopulation.find(d => d.label === explainBikeName && d.size_label === explainSize), explainPopulation)
```

[A summary of the published numbers, not a review: how a bike rides also depends on tyres, pressures, the load, and the rider. See [How geometry changes handling](handling.qmd) for what each number does.]{.data-note}

## The numbers behind the dots

```{ojs}
//| output: false
tableRows = filtered.map(d => ({
  Bike: d.label,
  Size: d.size_label,
  Setting: d.config,
  Category: categoryNames[d.category],
  Stack: d.stack,
  Reach: d.reach,
  "Stack/reach": d.stack_reach_ratio,
  "Head angle": d.head_tube_angle,
  "Seat angle": d.seat_tube_angle,
  "Fork offset": d.fork_offset_used,
  "Offset source": d.offset_estimated ? "estimated" : "published",
  Trail: d.trail_calc,
  Wheelbase: d.wheelbase,
  Chainstay: d.chainstay,
  "BB drop": d.bb_drop,
  "Toe clearance": d.toe_clearance,
  "Tyre clearance": d.tyre_clearance_mm,
  "Stock stem": d.stock_stem_length,
  "Bar stack": d.bar_stack,
  "Bar reach": d.bar_reach
}))
```

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(tableRows, {
  rows: 14,
  layout: "auto",

    "Stack/reach": x => x?.toFixed(2),
    Trail: x => x == null ? "" : x.toFixed(0),

    "Stock stem": x => x == null ? "not stated" : x.toFixed(0),

  }
})
```

```{ojs}
downloadButton = {
  const header = Object.keys(tableRows[0] ?? {Bike: ""});
  const esc = v => {
    const s = v == null ? "" : String(v);
    return /[",\n]/.test(s) ? `"${s.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : s;
  };
  const csv = [header.join(","), ...tableRows.map(r => header.map(h => esc(r[h])).join(","))].join("\n");
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv], {type: "text/csv"}));
  return html`<a class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" href="${url}" download="gravel-geometry-filtered.csv">Download these rows as CSV</a>`;
}
```

All lengths are in millimetres and angles in degrees. Trail, toe clearance, and estimated fork offsets are calculated by this site, not published by the manufacturers.

## What the columns mean

::: {.glossary}
Stack/reach
: Stack divided by reach. Higher means a more upright riding position.

Bar stack and bar reach
: Where the handlebar sits as sold: the vertical and horizontal distance from the bottom bracket to the centre of the stem's bar clamp, with each size's stock stem on 20 mm of spacers. Where a brand doesn't say which stem it fits, a standard stem for a 176 cm rider is assumed (90 mm at −6°). Frame stack and reach compare frames; bar stack and reach compare where your hands go out of the box.

Head angle
: How steeply the steering axis is tilted. Slacker (lower) angles feel calmer at speed. Steeper (higher) angles feel quicker to turn.

Seat angle
: How far forward the saddle sits over the pedals. Steeper angles put you further forward.

Fork offset
: How far the fork pushes the front axle ahead of the steering axis. Three brands don't publish it, so it's worked back from the wheelbase. Checked against bikes that do publish it, that method lands within 2 mm for 115 of 118 sizes.

Trail
: The gap on the ground between where the steering axis points and where the tyre touches down, calculated for a 700 × 45 mm tyre. More trail means steadier, self-centring steering. Gravel bikes mostly sit between 60 and 80 mm.

Wheelbase
: The distance between the axles. Longer is steadier, shorter is nimbler.

Chainstay
: The distance from the pedals' axle to the rear axle. Shorter feels livelier. Longer is steadier and leaves more room for tyres.

BB drop
: How far the pedals' axle sits below the wheel axles. More drop puts you lower between the wheels, which feels planted.

Toe clearance
: The gap between the pedal axle (crank pointing forward, 172.5 mm cranks) and the front tyre. A shoe usually reaches 90 to 110 mm ahead of the pedal axle, so smaller figures suggest your toe could touch the tyre in tight, slow turns.

Tyre clearance
: The widest tyre the manufacturer says fits, in their own words in the data file.
:::
